decisions.reason: Retaining current data during the controlled redeployment does not require restoring old-contract referral identities or changing the referral-code rules for NFTs in the active replacement contract.
The redeployment preserves existing data but does not change NFT transfer behavior or require recognition of legacy-contract transfers and benefits.
Preserving current backend data through redeployment is consistent with the existing reporting scope and does not entail including excluded legacy-contract referral or reward data.
The migration strategy does not change the Transak purchase flow or its rule that new fiat mints target the active replacement contract.
